objective.name: world.get_customer
objective.description: Look up a customer of the shop by identifier (name, tier, email, open orders).

#root.role: Return the customer record for the given customer identifier.

transformation_contract.morphing: A customer identifier becomes the customer record held by the shop.
invariants: The lookup is case-insensitive on the identifier.
An unknown identifier fails with a not-found error.
success: The response carries the customer with name, tier, email and open_orders.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper over a fixed in-memory shop world (test infrastructure, deterministic).
failure: customer_id missing or customer not found.

effects.tool_calls: Appends one entry to the tool_calls matter.
